[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Package the gateway, bind bootstrap issuance, advertise fleet [bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]protocol[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-fleet-surface[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-fleet-surface: in sase-core, make a normally installed wheel a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]usable dispatch target. Extract the gateway binary's startup into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reusable `run_gateway_cli(args)` library function and export a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase_gateway` console script from sase_core_py using the exact [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase_federation_worker` packaging pattern (Python shim, PyO3 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`py.allow_threads` wrapper, registered pyfunction), with argument [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handling, Tokio lifecycle, and clean shutdown preserved. Add a narrow [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dict-in/dict-out PyO3 binding over [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`FleetCredentialStore::issue_bootstrap` that keeps the default [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]600-second single-use TTL, installation-pin, and scope semantics, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never logs or echoes the secret. Extend the public health response with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a `fleet` object advertising `supported_protocol_versions` derived from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`FLEET_PROTOCOL_VERSION`, derive the contract snapshot's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`protocol_negotiation.supported_versions` from the same constant, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]regenerate both committed contract snapshots, and update every full-body[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]health assertion. Installed-wheel smoke tests for both console scripts.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Target-local `sase machine bootstrap` and packaged-command [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]resolution[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]machine-bootstrap-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-fleet-surface[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]machine-bootstrap-cli: add `sase machine bootstrap [-e|--expires [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]SECONDS] [-j|--json] [-s|--scope SCOPE ...]`, a target-local thin [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wrapper over the new issue_bootstrap binding that prints an enrollment [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bundle in exactly the format `MachineService._parse_enrollment_bundle` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accepts, using the same OS user and SASE home as the gateway; the secret[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]appears once on stdout and is never logged, echoed to prompts, or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accepted as an argv value. Fix packaged command resolution: [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`resolve_federation_worker_command` (and a sibling resolver for the new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase_gateway` console script) must also check [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`Path(sys.executable).parent`, because uv-tool installs put dependency [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]console scripts inside the tool venv without exposing them on PATH. Add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a non-deep doctor check that the federation worker command resolves [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]whenever machines are configured (mobile-gateway precedent). Update the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pinned machine-parser subcommand-set test.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Real builtin tailnet discovery with bounded probes and honest [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]defaults[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]tailnet-discovery[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tailnet-discovery: implement [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`BuiltinDispatchProviders.dispatch_discover` for real. Run `tailscale [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]status --json` without a shell under an enforced process deadline and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]output-size cap; parse the map-shaped Peer payload defensively (fixtures[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for missing/extra fields, self-exclusion, trailing-dot DNS, offline [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]peers, missing CLI, malformed and oversized output); form default [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`https://<node-dns>` endpoints from validated MagicDNS names; probe [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]candidates independently with per-peer and overall bounds, classifying [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compatibility from the public health response (its new `fleet` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]advertisement when present, `unknown` when absent, `incompatible` for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unrelated services). Online state and OS are advisory hints with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reasons, never exclusions. Return candidates plus structured diagnostics[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]so a broken provider or absent binary never renders as an empty [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]successful discovery, and stop swallowing provider exceptions silently. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Enforce a real wall-clock bound on provider hook execution. Make the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]builtin@tailnet spec's supports_discovery claim true. Flip defaults: [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`builtin@tailnet.enabled: true` and `discovery.enabled_providers: [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]\[builtin@tailnet]`, honoring explicit disablement and explaining (not [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]silently skipping) a disabled selection.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Third-party provider imports follow the finalizers trust model[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]provider-isolation[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]provider-isolation: today collect_dispatch_providers and helpers eagerly[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ep.load() third-party entry points in-process, which the parent plan's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dispatch-plugins phase explicitly forbade. Inventory entry points as [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]metadata in-process; import provider code only inside a bounded, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]separately supervised helper subprocess with a deadline and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cancellation, and only for the selected provider, following the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]finalizers loading model. A provider exception or timeout affects only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]its machines. Decide the dispatch_connection_plan hook: add it for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]third-party providers or record an explicit deferral decision (builtin [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]providers derive plans from enrolled machine records and do not need [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it).[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Canonical `sase machine init` with real activation and honest [bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]outcomes[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]machine-init[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tailnet-discovery[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]machine-init: add canonical `sase machine init` and refactor `sase init [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]machine` and the init-registry machine spec to delegate to one shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]machine-owned planner/apply service. Checks and previews stay offline; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]discovery runs only during explicit apply, after local identity setup. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Existing enrolled machines must not suppress an explicit rescan, while [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an all-enrolled or zero-machine registry must not leave `sase init [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--check` permanently red. Read enrollment bundles with a hidden prompt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](getpass), file, or stdin - never bare input(). Reuse `sase machine [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add`'s EnrollmentResult handling so quarantined or failed enrollment is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reported truthfully instead of the current unconditional 'Enrolled'. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]After write_machine_record on a chezmoi-enabled controller, deploy the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scoped change through the established apply_chezmoi mechanism honoring [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]its tracked-proc contract, reload the merged config, resolve the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]credential, and run an authenticated hello before declaring success; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]apply failure or partial enrollment leaves actionable recovery state [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]since the target may have consumed the bootstrap. Skip already-enrolled [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identities, never overwrite a pin during rescan, and route changed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity to `sase machine repair`. Fix stale docs/init.md wording and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add behavioral tests for the interactive flow.[/#D7D7AF]
